title: Raw RNA-Seq Data from gut microbiota in the Kazakh population
author: Tamara Vochshenkova
license_note: figshare article detail endpoint license.name: CC BY 4.0

steps.title: Extract bacterial DNA from stool
steps.instruction: Extract bacterial DNA from stool samples using the PurLink Genomic DNA Microbiome kit (Invitrogen, USA) following the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Measure extracted DNA concentration
steps.instruction: Measure the concentration of the extracted DNA with a Qubit™ 4 Fluorometer using the Qubit® dsDNA BR Assay Kit.

steps.title: Amplify 16S region and quantify
steps.instruction: Perform PCR amplification of the 16S hypervariable region, then purify the amplicon and measure its concentration.

substeps.instruction: Measure the concentration of the purified amplicon.

steps.title: Ligate barcode adapters and purify
steps.instruction: Ligate barcode adapters to the library and purify the adapter‑ligated library.

substeps.instruction: Ligate barcode adapters to the DNA library.

steps.title: Quantify final DNA library
steps.instruction: Measure the concentration of the resulting DNA libraries using the QuantStudio™ 12K Flex system with the Ion Library TaqMan® Quantitation Kit (Thermo Fisher Scientific, USA).
